_meta.purpose: Cifra multi-instrumento de The End (Pearl Jam, Backspacer 2009).
_meta.note_compasso: Tom F#, 118 BPM. Strumming especial: down/muted/down/up/down/muted/down/up.

title: The End
content:
{section: Intro}
[F#5]

{section: Verso 1}
[F#5]                              [D#m]               [F#5]
What were all those dreams we shared those many years ago?
[F#5]                [D#m]                     [F#5]
What were all those plans we made now left beside the road?
  [D#m]              [F#5]
Behind  us in the road

{section: Verso 2}
[F#5]                    [D#m]                   [F#5]
"More than friends," I always pledged cause friends, they come and go
[F#5]    [D#m]            [F#5]
People change, as does everything, I wanted to grow old
  [D#m]                [F#5]
I just  want to grow old

{section: Refrão}
[F#]       [B]    [F#]    [B]           [F#]     [G#7]
Slide up next to me, I'm just a human being
[B]              [C#]      [D#m]                  [C#]           [B]
I will take the blame, but just the same, this is not me
    [B]   [D#m]  [B]    [D#m]
You see? Believe
    [B]               [Bsus2]
I'm better than this
[B5]    [F#]    [B]   [F#]   [B]                 [F#] [G#7]
Don't leave me so cold or buried beneath the stones
[B]             [C#] [D#m]              [C#]          [B]    [D#m]
I just want to hold on and know I'm worth your love
 [B]     [D#m]        [B]    [D#m]
Enough, I don't think
        [B]           [Bsus2] [B5] [F#5]
There's such a thing

{section: Verso 3}
[F#5]              [D#m]              [F#5]
It's my fault now, I been caught a sickness in my bones
[F#5]       [D#m]                [F#5]
How it pains to leave you here with the kids on your own
[D#m]               [F#5]
Just don't let me go

{section: Refrão 2}
[F#]      [B]  [F#]        [B]              [F#]    [G#7]
Help me see myself, cause I can no longer tell
[B]               [C#]    [D#m]           [C#]    [B]    [D#m]
Lookin out from the inside of the bottom of a well
     [B]    [D#m]  [B]   [D#m]
It's hell, I yell
    [B]           [Bsus2]
But no one hears
[B5] [F#] [B] [F#] [B]            [F#]   [G#7]
Before I disappear, whisper in my ear
[B]                [C#]   [D#m]        [C#]         [B]   [D#m]
Give me something to echo in my unknown future's ear
   [B]    [D#m]    [B]  [D#m]
My dear, the end
      [B]    [D#m]    [B]   [D#m]
Comes near, I'm here
    [B]
But not much longer
